episodes.title: Tithing: Is it a Sin Not to Tithe? How Much?
episodes.short: Tithing: Is it a Sin Not to Tithe? How Much?
episodes.description: Do Catholics and all Christians Have to Tithe? What does the Bible Say we have to give and to whom do we give it? What is the difference from the Old and New Testaments about this act of charity? What did Jesus say about it? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain.

episodes.title: Fulton Sheen: The Amazing Story. Why Beatification Now?
episodes.short: Fulton Sheen: The Amazing Story. Why Beatification Now?
episodes.description: We all know the name Fulton Sheen, but do we know the person? Why did it take so long for him to be Beatified? What were the controversies that played a factor? Was he lax on contraception? Did he criticize Vatican II? What did he warn us about Communism? Listen to Fr. Chris Alar tell the whole story of this man on the way to being the first American-born male saint.

episodes.title: Anti-Popes: Is the Chair of Peter Empty? Can We Have a Heretical Pope?
episodes.short: Anti-Popes: Is the Chair of Peter Empty? Can We Have a Heretical Pope?
episodes.description: What is an Anti-Pope? Are they evil or Satanic? Or are they just men who claim they are the rightful Pope. And how does the Church determine the real Pope? Many claim the Chair of Peter is empty and the last two Popes are heretical. Can this be possible? And if so, how? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains this and more!

episodes.title: Excommunication: When? SSPX? Vigano? Abortion?
episodes.short: Excommunication: When? SSPX? Vigano? Abortion?
episodes.description: Do we know that Excommunication is not a punishment? Do we know why it is given? Why isn't it given more? Was SSPX excommunicated? What are the 8 ways you can excommunicate yourself? What is the difference between Ferendae Sententiae and Latae Sententiae? Learn these answers and many more about Excommunication and what it really involves as Fr. Chris Alar puts it into an easy-to-understand teaching.

episodes.title: Did Catholics Change the Sabbath? What is Allowed on Sunday?
episodes.short: Did Catholics Change the Sabbath? What is Allowed on Sunday?
episodes.description: Did Catholics change the 10 Commandments? Do we keep Holy the Sabbath or the Lord's Day? Why do we worship on Sunday rather than Saturday? What activities are allowed on Sunday, for Sunday Rest, and what activities are forbidden and why? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains all this and more!

episodes.title: Answering More Divine Mercy Attacks: Horns, No Wounds, Snakes | Part 3
episodes.short: Answering More Divine Mercy Attacks: Horns, No Wounds, Snakes | Part 3
episodes.description: Although this video can be watched and understood independently from the first two videos, part 3 addresses and explains common misunderstandings about St. Faustina and Divine Mercy. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives you an easy-to-understand summary that will prove definitively that the message and devotion of Divine Mercy are from God. But the Image has no wounds! There is a snake in the image! Jesus has horns! It was made by Freemasons! These are all answered here, plus more. Remember, there is nothing Satan wants more than for you to reject God's Divine Mercy!

episodes.title: Answering More Criticisms of St. Faustina & Divine Mercy | Part 2
episodes.short: Answering More Criticisms of St. Faustina & Divine Mercy | Part 2
episodes.description: In part 2, Fr. Chris Alar addresses more attacks against Divine Mercy, St. Faustina, and the Diary of St. Faustina in the video "Faustina & The Divine Mercy Deception" by Br. Michael Dimond of vaticancatholic.com. He explains what the criticisms are and the correct answers to the misunderstandings. He also explains the truth about Most Holy Family Monastery and vaticancatholic.com, neither of which are in union with the Catholic Church.

episodes.title: Meaning of Freedom: America 250 One Nation Under God's Mercy
episodes.short: Meaning of Freedom: America 250 One Nation Under God's Mercy
episodes.description: America 250 has significance not just in the United States but around the world. The importance of freedom and religious liberty affects every human on earth. What do you need to know about it? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains how the Catholic Church was the most important piece of the founding of America and how it shaped Western civilization.

episodes.title: Finally! Responding to Divine Mercy Criticisms! | Part 1
episodes.short: Finally! Responding to Divine Mercy Criticisms! | Part 1
episodes.description: We have all heard it before: Divine Mercy is not authentic. It was banned. The Image of Divine Mercy is not correct. John Paul II only approved it because it was Polish. It is of Satan! Now, Fr. Chris Alar begins a new series of talks answering every one of these attacks and explains in detail why they are not correct.

episodes.title: Sts. Thomas More & John Fisher: Do a Fortnight of Freedom
episodes.short: Sts. Thomas More & John Fisher: Do a Fortnight of Freedom
episodes.description: St.Thomas More and St. John Fisher are names we recognize but do we fully understand what they did and how we are still doing what they stood against? How did Henry VIII and Bloody Mary affect the course of history? As they both showed, defending the Faith and the gifts God gives us, such as marriage and the Church, is something worth dying for. Hear Fr. Chris Alar tell their amazing story.

episodes.title: Ad Orientem (to the East): Why There is a Controversy
episodes.short: Ad Orientem (to the East): Why There is a Controversy
episodes.description: In Traditionis Custodes Pope Francis implemented restrictions on the Extraordinary Form of the Mass. But did that apply to the Novus Ordo Mass celebrated Ad Orientem? Is this allowed, and if so, is permission needed? What is more traditional, the priest facing toward, or away from, the people? What are the reasons this priestly posture should or should not be done? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain this in detail and tell why it has been so controversial.

episodes.title: Why Now? Consecration of Nations to the Sacred Heart for the 250th
episodes.short: Why Now? Consecration of Nations to the Sacred Heart for the 250th
episodes.description: We have all heard about the Sacred Heart of Jesus, but do we really know what God asks of us through it? Do we understand the importance and how we as a single disciple can change the world? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain why the United States waited so long to Consecrate to the Sacred Heart of Jesus and how we can avoid being like France in being too late.

episodes.title: The Visitation: Amazing & New!
episodes.short: The Visitation: Amazing & New!
episodes.description: We all know the story of the Visitation in the Gospel of Luke. But do you know the full meaning? What is the symbolism and literal interpretation by the Church Fathers? What is the Connection to the Book of Revelation? Is Mary the New Ark of the Covenant? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain with all new details about this amazing event in the Bible.

episodes.title: The Two Pentecosts in the Bible & the 2nd Pentecost to Come!
episodes.short: The Two Pentecosts in the Bible & the 2nd Pentecost to Come!
episodes.description: We know about Pentecost and the Holy Spirit from the Bible in Acts 2, but do you know there were two Pentecosts in Scripture, including John 20? And what is the Second Pentecost still to come? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain all about Pentecost and some fascinating aspects of it that most people have never heard of.

episodes.title: Amazing Story of St. Rita! The Saint of Impossible Cases
episodes.short: Amazing Story of St. Rita! The Saint of Impossible Cases
episodes.description: We all know the top saints who can help us with specific needs. But how about impossible cases? That would be the job for St. Rita. Make her your patron saint and find out how she can help you now. Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain her amazing story!

episodes.title: The Angels and the Ascension: What We Didn't Know
episodes.short: The Angels and the Ascension: What We Didn't Know
episodes.description: Surprisingly, Fr. Chris Alar has never done a Saturday Talk on the Ascension of Jesus into Heaven. Join him now as he explains some fascinating facts that most of us do not know, including how the angels were involved!

episodes.title: The Hidden Life of the Holy Family from the Mystics (PART 2)
episodes.short: The Hidden Life of the Holy Family from the Mystics (PART 2)
episodes.description: In Part 2 of 2, what did the Holy Family (Jesus, Mary and Joseph) talk about and do but was not recorded in the Bible? How do we know this? Answer: from tradition and from the mystics such as Bl. Anne Catherine Emmerich, Ven. Mary of Agreda, St. Bridget of Sweden and St. Elizabeth of Schonau. Join Fr. Chris as he summarizes what these mystics have said about what happened within the Holy Family during their time in Egypt, during their hidden life in Nazareth, during the death of St. Joseph, and during the public ministry of Jesus. Interesting stories are given (such as what the first words of

episodes.title: The Hidden Life of the Holy Family from the Mystics (PART 1)
episodes.short: The Hidden Life of the Holy Family from the Mystics (PART 1)
episodes.description: In Part 1 of 2, what did the Holy Family (Jesus, Mary and Joseph) talk about and do but was not recorded in the Bible? How do we know this? Answer: from tradition and from the mystics such as Bl. Anne Catherine Emmerich, Ven. Mary of Agreda, St. Bridget of Sweden and St. Elizabeth of Schonau. Join Fr. Chris as he summarizes what these mystics have said about what happened within the Holy Family during their time in Egypt, during their hidden life in Nazareth, during the death of St. Joseph, and during the public ministry of Jesus. Interesting stories are given (such as what the first words of

episodes.title: Most Popular Saint in the World After Mary & Joseph: St. George
episodes.short: Most Popular Saint in the World After Mary & Joseph: St. George
episodes.description: Few people know that outside the United States, the most popular saint in the world is St. George! Why? Was the story of him slaying a dragon real? Why is he honored in Islam? Hear Fr. Chris Alar tell this incredible story of the saint you need to know more about, because the rest of the world does.

episodes.title: Divine Mercy in the Liturgy: It's NOT Just a Devotion!
episodes.short: Divine Mercy in the Liturgy: It's NOT Just a Devotion!
episodes.description: Divine Mercy is both a Message and a Devotion. As JPII and Pope Benedict stated, the message of Divine Mercy is NOT optional. It is the "nucleus of the Gospel" and an integral part of Christian life and prayer - not a secondary devotion. So in answer to all the criticism about St. Faustina and the devotional of Divine Mercy, Fr. Chris Alar explains where Divine is within the Mass: EVERYWHERE!

episodes.title: Meaning of the Stations of the Cross: Learn a Quick Way to Pray!
episodes.short: Meaning of the Stations of the Cross: Learn a Quick Way to Pray!
episodes.description: We all know about the Stations of the Cross but many people don't pray them often because they are inconvenient to get to and take too long to pray. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives you a better understanding of why we pray the Stations, how to understand them better, and a new way to pray them quickly!

episodes.title: The Last Supper: A Summary of Its Meaning
episodes.short: The Last Supper: A Summary of Its Meaning
episodes.description: What we know about the Last Supper comes from the Bible, but what is the significance and the theology behind what Christ did? What is the symbolism and the teaching that Christ wants us to learn? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he shares with us what he learned in seminary about the Last Supper and help you to understand it in a better way than ever before.

episodes.title: Complete Summary and Meaning of Palm Sunday
episodes.short: Complete Summary and Meaning of Palm Sunday
episodes.description: We all know about receiving palms on Passion Sunday, and we know we read the account of the Crucifixion at Mass, but what else is important about this day? What are the traditions of Christians for centuries that are still in place but have also been lost? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain.

episodes.title: Book of Job: Meaning of Suffering? It's More Than That!
episodes.short: Book of Job: Meaning of Suffering? It's More Than That!
episodes.description: We all know the story of poor Job. He was a good and righteous man but God allowed him to endure suffering beyond imagination. Why? The answer may surprise you - it isn't what you think. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains why this book of the Bible is different from any other.

episodes.title: Saints Perpetua & Felicity: What I Learned in Seminary
episodes.short: Saints Perpetua & Felicity: What I Learned in Seminary
episodes.description: With so many Christian martyrs over the centuries, why do we remember these two and not many others? What really happened and how was one treated as the slave of the other? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains their incredible story and how it can help us today.

episodes.title: Lying: This Will Surprise You!
episodes.short: Lying: This Will Surprise You!
episodes.description: At one time or another, most people have said things that would not be considered 100% accurate. Some have told outright lies. So what does the Bible and the Church say if there is a time ever allowed to do this? What if it is only a white lie to protect someone or to not offend them? Is it ever justified? What is the danger of lying? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains this very practical topic.

episodes.title: A New Summary of Lent! A Guide for All Christians
episodes.short: A New Summary of Lent! A Guide for All Christians
episodes.description: We all grew up with Lent, but are we currently living it? What does Lent mean and where is it commanded in the Bible? What exactly is optional and what is mandatory for us to do? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains in this new talk what you need to know about Lent and why it is so important.

episodes.title: The Real St. Valentine & the Meaning of Commitment
episodes.short: The Real St. Valentine & the Meaning of Commitment
episodes.description: We all know about St. Valentine's Day - but do we really? Was he a real person? What did he do that became stories of legend and historical truth? Join Fr. Chris Alar as explains who this saint was, what the spirituality of St. Valentine's Day really is, and how is love really defined.

episodes.title: Sports on Sunday & When Does it Become an Idol?
episodes.short: Sports on Sunday & When Does it Become an Idol?
episodes.description: Whether or not you're a sports fan or not, you know a sports fan. So what does the Church teach about sports? Is it okay to watch or participate on Sundays? What about the Superbowl? When does it cross the line from recreation to sin? Hear Fr. Chris summarize this in a fun and easy-to-understand way!

episodes.title: Explaining What the Creed Means Line by Line
episodes.short: Explaining What the Creed Means Line by Line
episodes.description: Every Sunday at Mass we pray the Nicene Creed. But do we "pray" it or do we only "say" it? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains the meaning of what we profess in our faith by looking at each sentence. For example, why doesn't the Creed mention Jesus descent into Hell but the Apostles' Creed does? When we profess that we believe in "one, holy, Catholic and Apostolic Church" do we mean the Roman Catholic Church? Actually not. This and many other insights await you in this video.

episodes.title: St. Damien of Molokai & Marianne Cope: Amazing!
episodes.short: St. Damien of Molokai & Marianne Cope: Amazing!
episodes.description: Everyone loves Hawaii, but what many don't know is two of the most significant saints of our modern times shaped the world in mercy from one little island. The story of their work and the conditions is utterly fascinating and unbelievable by today's standards. St. Damien of Molokai and St. Marianne Cope changed the world and they can change you, too. Hear Fr. Chris Alar tell their amazing story!

episodes.title: What Really Happened at Cana and Why It Matters
episodes.short: What Really Happened at Cana and Why It Matters
episodes.description: We all know what happened at Cana but what is the deeper meaning? It is much more than Jesus just turning water into wine. With so much to understand in this one passage, Fr. Chris Alar breaks it down so it is easy to understand and will help you to understand the significance of the role of Mary as intercessor. It is Biblical!

episodes.title: It Begins Here! Venezuela Prophecy of Servant of God Maria Esperanza
episodes.short: It Begins Here! Venezuela Prophecy of Servant of God Maria Esperanza
episodes.description: With special guest, Maria's daughter, who also speaks! With the world in chaos, major events are unfolding in Venezuela. What prophecy by a declared "Servant of God" gives us the insight to understand what is happening and why? What do we need to do? Fr. Chris Alar explains this and the incredible approved apparitions of Betania, Venezuela.

episodes.title: Holy Name of Jesus - God's Name in Vain? More Than a Curse Word!
episodes.short: Holy Name of Jesus - God's Name in Vain? More Than a Curse Word!
episodes.description: The Meaning of the Holy Name of Jesus and why we celebrate it as a Feast on January 3. In this easy-to-understand talk, Fr. Chris Alar explains the symbols of Jesus' name, like IHS, and why using God's name in vain is much more than simply swearing.

episodes.title: Mary: Jewish Promise to Christian Reality
episodes.short: Mary: Jewish Promise to Christian Reality
episodes.description: In this brand new talk on Mary, Fr. Chris Alar explains how she is the fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy. Foretold by the prophets, how do we show that Mary is the answer to the Biblical Promise of the Jews to the Christian reality of being the mother of Jesus, the Messiah. Watch this easy-to-understand presentation that shows many things you didn't know to understand who Mary was and her role in salvation history.

episodes.title: How to Show Jesus is the Jewish Messiah
episodes.short: How to Show Jesus is the Jewish Messiah
episodes.description: Does Christmas have Jewish origins? If so, what are they and why are they important? We all wonder why the Jews still do not (en masse) accept Christ as the Messiah. What are the reasons for this and why don't they believe Jesus is their Savior of Prophecy? Fr. Chris Alar explains some interesting points that show how Jesus has fulfilled all of the Old Testament prophecies so you can better explain who He is.

episodes.title: Incredible Story of St. Lucy: Patron of Eyes & How She Can Help
episodes.short: Incredible Story of St. Lucy: Patron of Eyes & How She Can Help
episodes.description: We have many Saints in the Church, so why is St. Lucy so special and how do we benefit from her intercession? Why do we need saints? And what was it that she did to help us today? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain this amazing story about a saint they couldn't kill, move, or make blind.

episodes.title: Body & Organ Donation: What is Allowed & What is Not?
episodes.short: Body & Organ Donation: What is Allowed & What is Not?
episodes.description: We have all heard about donating our organs or body to science, but what does the Church say about it? Is it allowed? If so, under what circumstances? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he shows you everything you need to know about this topic and why it is so important.

episodes.title: Music's Incredible Control Over Us: How can St. Cecilia Help?
episodes.short: Music's Incredible Control Over Us: How can St. Cecilia Help?
episodes.description: Few things can control our emotions and feelings like music. There is scientific proof of this. So how do we know these limits and boundaries? Hear Fr. Chris explain the power of music for the good or the bad and how St. Cecilia can help us.

episodes.title: The Presentation of Jesus or Mary? A Simple Summary
episodes.short: The Presentation of Jesus or Mary? A Simple Summary
episodes.description: We all know about the Presentation of Jesus, but what about the Presentation of Mary? Is this in the Bible? What is the Protoevangelium of James and is it inspired by the Holy Spirit? Fr. Chris Alar gives a good summary of what it is, what we believe, and why.

episodes.title: Understanding Purgatory and Proof It Exists
episodes.short: Understanding Purgatory and Proof It Exists
episodes.description: Non-Catholics often reject the doctrine of Purgatory, claiming it is not Biblical. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains where it is in the Bible and easy steps to do now to avoid the most extreme punishment after we die.

episodes.title: Praying to Dead People? All Saints' Day
episodes.short: Praying to Dead People? All Saints' Day
episodes.description: The practice of praying to the saints for intercession is as old as Christianity. So why is it so misunderstood? Can the saints hear us? Aren't they dead? Doesn't this take away honor from God? Do we worship them? Fr. Chris Alar answers all this and more!

episodes.title: Cremation: Is It Allowed?
episodes.short: Cremation: Is It Allowed?
episodes.description: Many people today are turning to cremation as an easy, low-cost alternative to Christian burial. But is this really allowed by the Church? And if so, what do you need to know before you do this? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives an interesting summary of this important topic.

episodes.title: What Does the Church Say About Israel & Gaza?
episodes.short: What Does the Church Say About Israel & Gaza?
episodes.description: The terror and violence in the Israeli / Palestinian conflict is reaching a fever pitch with Hamas and the fear of World War III looming over the world. But who is right? What is happening and why? And what does the Church and the Bible say about it regarding the end times? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he summarizes this and gives you the most important information to understand and make sense of it.

episodes.title: Why Did Jesus Choose St. Faustina Kowalska?
episodes.short: Why Did Jesus Choose St. Faustina Kowalska?
episodes.description: Join us at the National Shrine of The Divine Mercy for a special talk with Fr. Chris Alar in honor of the Feast of St. Faustina Kowalska, the Secretary and Apostle of Divine Mercy. St. Faustina was entrusted by Christ with the mission of proclaiming His message of Divine Mercy to the world, a mission that continues to transform lives through her Diary, through prayer, and through the Sacraments. On this special day, Fr. Chris will guide us deeper into the life, message, and spirituality of St. Faustina, helping us see how her trust in Jesus remains a path of hope and holiness for our times. Th

episodes.title: Can We Attend Weddings Outside of the Catholic Church?
episodes.short: Can We Attend Weddings Outside of the Catholic Church?
episodes.description: With so many Catholics marrying non-Catholics today, and even Catholics marrying Catholics but outside of the Church, how are we to approach it? Can we attend? If not, what do we do to save the relationship? Fr. Chris Alar answers this in an easy-to-understand way.

episodes.title: St. Louis? Fr. Chris Alar's Top 5!
episodes.short: St. Louis? Fr. Chris Alar's Top 5!
episodes.description: Do you know the story of St. Louis? Fr. Chris explains one of the most incredible saints in the history of the Church and explains the tie to the city of St. Louis and the meaning of the words he spoke.

episodes.title: Understanding the Sacraments: A New Summary! (Part 2 of 2)
episodes.short: Understanding the Sacraments: A New Summary! (Part 2 of 2)
episodes.description: In part 1, Fr. Chris Alar gave amazing facts you didn't know about Baptism, Confession, and the Eucharist. Here in Part 2, he continues with what we need to know about Confirmation, Marriage (is yours valid?), the Priesthood, and Anointing of the Sick. What is covered will surprise you since what we thought we knew as Catholics is often not complete.

episodes.title: Understanding the Sacraments: A New Summary! (Part 1 of 2)
episodes.short: Understanding the Sacraments: A New Summary! (Part 1 of 2)
episodes.description: Fr. Chris Alar has spoken on the different sacraments many times on Saturday talks, homilies, missions, etc. He has explained why the Sacraments are so important (necessary for salvation) and what makes the Catholic Church different from all others. However, these talks are scattered all over the internet. Now, he has put them all together in one place, summarized better than ever before. Find the answers to questions such as Why do we baptize infants? Where is Confession in the Bible? Is your marriage valid? and many more!

episodes.title: The Amazing Story of Our Lady of Good Counsel
episodes.short: The Amazing Story of Our Lady of Good Counsel
episodes.description: With all the Marian devotions in the Church, what makes OLGC so important? What is the incredible story behind it and what are the incredible graces we can get from it? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain.

episodes.title: Immaculate Heart of Mary: What Does it Mean?
episodes.short: Immaculate Heart of Mary: What Does it Mean?
episodes.description: In this new talk on the Immaculate Heart of Mary and Sacred Heart of Jesus, Fr. Chris Alar gives updated information about this incredibly important devotion in the Church. But what does it mean and what do we have to do to receive the graces promised by Christ?

episodes.title: Who is Pope Leo XIV? What Can We Expect From Our Shepherd?
episodes.short: Who is Pope Leo XIV? What Can We Expect From Our Shepherd?
episodes.description: Habemus Papam! What can we expect from Cardinal Robert Prevost who was elected as the new pope? While we trust that God is at work, we also need to know our new Bishop of Rome, our new Shepherd. Listen as Fr. Chris Alar explains who Leo XIV is, from his own words.

episodes.title: Answering Questions about Divine Mercy Sunday
episodes.short: Answering Questions about Divine Mercy Sunday
episodes.description: In his most detailed talk yet about Divine Mercy Sunday, Fr. Chris Alar explains how to get the grace promised by Jesus and explains why this is not optional. While the theology is deep, Fr. Chris makes it easy to understand. episodes.title: Our Lady of Grace: What We Must Do to Get to Heaven
episodes.short: Our Lady of Grace: What We Must Do to Get to Heaven
episodes.description: Grace is the only way we get to Heaven. But what is it? What do you have to do to get it? Through Our Lady of Grace we learn why grace, lived in love, is the most important thing of all. Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain why this Marian devotion is the most important of all. episodes.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI): Help or Mark of the Beast?
episodes.short: Artificial Intelligence (AI): Help or Mark of the Beast?
episodes.description: Few things have changed the world more in the last two years than AI. But what does the Church say about it? Is is good and helpful, or dangerous and demonic? Can it be used without opening portals? Fr. Chris Alar explains. To access our weekly podcast, go to your preferred podcasting platform and search: Explaining the Faith Discover more about the Catholic faith on Divine Mercy Plus! episodes.title: Garabandal: Can We Believe In It?
episodes.short: Garabandal: Can We Believe In It?
episodes.description: One of the most frightening but informative Marian apparitions in history happened at Garabandal, Spain, in the 1960s. What was this message and why is it important today? Can we believe this message and what has the Church officially said about it? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains all you need to know and what you need to do in order to follow what Heaven is asking for. To access our weekly podcast, go to your preferred podcasting platform and search: Explaining the Faith Discover more about the Catholic faith on Divine Mercy Plus! Support Our Ministries Fair Use Policy

episodes.title: What Does the Church Teach About Immigration? Open Borders?
episodes.short: What Does the Church Teach About Immigration? Open Borders?
episodes.description: Completely different content from Fr. Chris' recent homily on this topic. With so much confusion about immigration today, what do Christians need to know? Should we have open borders? What does Jesus and the Bible say? Is Pope Francis right on this issue? Does his letter to the Catholic Bishops have to be followed? Hear Fr. Chris Alar answer these questions and more! To access our weekly podcast, go to your preferred podcasting platform and search: Explaining the Faith Discover more about the Catholic faith on Divine Mercy Plus! Support Our Ministries Fair Use Policy

episodes.title: Is Being a Good Person Most Important to Acquire Heaven? NO!
episodes.short: Is Being a Good Person Most Important to Acquire Heaven? NO!
episodes.description: Today, most Christians believe that if they are only "a good person" they will get to Heaven. This is not correct. What Jesus and the Bible say about getting to Heaven involves much more. Is it through faith alone? Is it through doing good works? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain exactly what Jesus said we need to do to find eternal life. To access our weekly podcast, go to your preferred podcasting platform and search: Explaining the Faith Discover more about the Catholic faith on Divine Mercy Plus! Support Our Ministries Fair Use Policy

episodes.title: Holy Face Devotion: Perfect Reparation
episodes.short: Holy Face Devotion: Perfect Reparation
episodes.description: One of the most powerful devotions in history, and one that keeps surfacing around the world, is the Holy Face (from the Veil of Veronica and the Shroud of Turin). What is so powerful about this and how do we differentiate one image of Christ from another? How did they come to be? Fr. Chris Alar explains this incredible gift of grace. episodes.title: The 1st Ever Devotion to Mary: Our Lady Help of Christians
episodes.short: The 1st Ever Devotion to Mary: Our Lady Help of Christians

episodes.title: Limbo? Unbaptized in Heaven? Answer: Holy Innocents
episodes.short: Limbo? Unbaptized in Heaven? Answer: Holy Innocents

episodes.short: Our Lady of Knock and Our Lady of Pontmain: What Heaven Said - Explaining the Faith
episodes.description: Two extremely important, but lesser known Marian apparitions, occurred in France and Ireland. Being incredibly important countries to the Faith, we need to listen to Mary's message from Heaven regarding these visions. Hear Fr. Chris Alar summarize in an interesting way the story of Our Lady of Knock and Our Lady of Pontmain.

episodes.title: Image of Divine Mercy: History, Meaning, Miracles
episodes.short: Image of Divine Mercy: History, Meaning, Miracles
episodes.description: We have talked about the Divine Mercy Image before, but never quite like this. Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain in an easy-to-understand way the history and meaning of the Image of Divine Mercy and some of the many miracles reported by those from having the Image in their homes in thisd episode of Explaning the Faith.

episodes.title: Women of the Bible: Jesus' Good and Bad Ancestors
episodes.short: Women of the Bible: Jesus' Good and Bad Ancestors
episodes.description: Who were Rachel, Ruth, Rebecca, Rahab or Judith or Esther? What was their role in salvation history and what do you need to know? Did Jesus really have relatives who were prostitutes? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain this fascinating account of women in the bible and learn what you never knew before.

episodes.title: Our Lady of Gietrzwald
episodes.short: Our Lady of Gietrzwald
episodes.description: Join Fr. Chris Alar, MIC, as he explains a critically important Marian apparitions that you haven't heard about. Gietrzwald (the only approved apparition in Poland) will give you a much better understanding of Mary's role in God's Kingdom.

episodes.title: Pope John Paul II: Amazing Mercy Pope
episodes.short: Pope John Paul II: Amazing Mercy Pope
episodes.description: Do we really know who John Paul II was? Hear Fr. Chris Alar explain some incredible facts and stories of this pope who was called "The Greatest Man of the 20th century?" What was his role that God gave him directly? What did he really teach? And why did many want him dead? You won't think of him the same way again.

episodes.title: Martin Luther vs. St. Therese: Debunking the Myths of Reformation vs. Revolt
episodes.short: Martin Luther vs. St. Therese: Debunking the Myths of Reformation vs. Revolt
episodes.description: Was Martin Luther a hero of justice or a disobedient leader of revolt? Hear Fr. Chris Alar give the often misunderstood facts and debunk many common myths about one of the Fathers of the Protestant Reformation. Also, hear how similar he was to St. Therese of Lisieux, but how they went down totally different roads.

episodes.title: Carlo Acutis: The Saint of the Internet and Millennials
episodes.short: Carlo Acutis: The Saint of the Internet and Millennials
episodes.description: With the challenges of our youth today being enormous, Fr. Chris Alar presents Blessed Carlo Acutis as an example to live by. Learn about this incredible saint who is the best example for our children today growing up in a time so influenced by the digital world.

episodes.title: La Salette: What Heaven is Telling Us
episodes.short: La Salette: What Heaven is Telling Us
episodes.description: What is the chilling message that Mary gave at La Salette, France, and why is it important today? Hear Fr. Chris Alar summarize this critical apparition and tell us what we need to know and what we need to do to follow Heaven's instruction.

episodes.title: The Rapture: Is it Biblical?
episodes.short: The Rapture: Is it Biblical?
episodes.description: What does it mean to be "left behind?" How will the Second Coming of Christ be realized? What is the Rapture and who will be affected? Will only Christians be "raptured" or is the Rapture not even Biblical? What does Pre-, Mid-, or Post-Tribulation mean? Is there a 1,000 year reign of Christ again on earth? What is Pre-, A-, and Post-Millenialism? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives you Church teaching in an easy-to-understand way.

episodes.title: Evolution: What the Church Actually Teaches
episodes.short: Evolution: What the Church Actually Teaches
episodes.description: Many of us are confused about evolution. What is it and does it go against the Bible? Does the Catholic Church say it is permissible to believe in evolution? If so, what kind of evolution? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives an actual easy answer to this centuries-long dilemma.

episodes.title: How To Become a Saint: It is NOT What You Think!
episodes.short: How To Become a Saint: It is NOT What You Think!
episodes.description: We all believe that becoming a saint is out of our reach... long prayers, extreme penances, and superhuman virtue. While those things are characteristic of canonized saints, surprisingly those elements are not what defines holiness. So what does? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives you the answer.

episodes.title: The Truth of Galileo: Church vs. Science?
episodes.short: The Truth of Galileo: Church vs. Science?
episodes.description: What is the truth about the Church and Galileo? It is not what you have always heard. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he takes you back to seminary and tells the truth of what really happened with Galileo and the Church's view about science.

episodes.title: Marian Consecration
episodes.short: Marian Consecration
episodes.description: Join Fr. Chris Alar and on a recently released video of a parish mission in Pennsylvania, where he explains the concepts and reasons why we should all embrace Marian Consecration. Catholics need to be able to explain this tradition when questioned by non-Catholic friends and family.

episodes.title: Our Lady of Good Success: What it Means for Today
episodes.short: Our Lady of Good Success: What it Means for Today
episodes.description: There are many approved Marian apparitions, but few capture the essence of our times more than Our Lady of Good Success. Appearing to a nun, Mother Mariana, in Ecuador in the 16th century, Mary's words were a message to us at the end of the 20th century. Loss of faith and morals were foretold - but so was a remedy. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains this critically important message from heaven.

episodes.title: Inquisition: What Really Happened and Why
episodes.short: Inquisition: What Really Happened and Why
episodes.description: As Catholics we are told, and believe, that the Spanish Inquisition was nothing but Catholic Church oppression, torture, and power control. We are told millions died at the hands of the church, killed because they would not become Catholic. Is that what really happened? Fr. Chris Alar explains.

episodes.title: St. Charbel: The Saint with Most Miracles Ever?
episodes.short: St. Charbel: The Saint with Most Miracles Ever?
episodes.description: Of the over 10,000 saints in the history of the Church, which saint, other than Mary, has the most miracles? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains the incredible life, miracles, and incorruptibility of St. Charbel (or Sharbel) Makhlouf of the Maronite Rite in Lebanon.

episodes.title: Papal Infallibility?
episodes.short: Papal Infallibility?
episodes.description: What does it mean to be the Vicar of Christ? What does Church teaching that the Pope is infallible really mean? It isn't what you think. Join Fr. Chris Alar as he explains what the Church really teaches about the papacy, the Ordinary Magisterium, the Extraordinary Magisterium, Apostolic Succession, Ex Cathedra, etc. and if the Pope can make an error or not.

episodes.title: Freemasonry: Meaning and Mission
episodes.short: Freemasonry: Meaning and Mission
episodes.description: What is Freemasonry and why does the Catholic Church condemn it? Is it justified or a misunderstanding? Join Fr. Chris Alar as he gives the history and meaning behind this secret society and what their defined mission actually is.

episodes.title: Mary, Patroness of the United States and Her Apparitions Here
episodes.short: Mary, Patroness of the United States and Her Apparitions Here
episodes.description: Fr. Chris Alar explains Mary's role in the history of America and her being made patroness of the United States under the title of the Immaculate Conception. Also discussed is the only approved Marian apparition in the U.S. at Champion, WI and the significance of the date July 2. Also, has the Church approved Our Lady of America and George Washington's apparition of Mary?

episodes.title: Why Does God Allow Suffering, Illness, Tragedy, etc.?
episodes.short: Why Does God Allow Suffering, Illness, Tragedy, etc.?
episodes.description: What is the meaning of suffering, sickness, loss, and death? Why would a "merciful" God allow such things? Fr. Chris Alar answers these questions in a powerful way that will give you the strength to understand and persevere in the midst of such trials.

episodes.title: New Age: Yoga, Reiki, Ouija Boards, Horoscopes
episodes.short: New Age: Yoga, Reiki, Ouija Boards, Horoscopes
episodes.description: Does the Church allow Yoga, Reiki, Ouija Boards, Horoscopes, dream catchers, Astrology, Tai Chi, tarot cards, etc., or are these New Age superstitions? Fr. Chris Alar explains.

episodes.title: Theology of the Body: Church Teaching on Sex
episodes.short: Theology of the Body: Church Teaching on Sex
episodes.description: What is Church and Bible Teaching on Sex? Is all sexual activity allowed within marriage? Are we called to different levels of chastity? Are heterosexual sins as serious as homosexual sins? Fr. Chris Alar explains the powerful teaching of Theology of the Body, something so important yet so misunderstood such as marriage and contraception.

episodes.title: Understanding Mary: How to Explain Her Role
episodes.short: Understanding Mary: How to Explain Her Role
episodes.description: Mary is the most misunderstood gift of our faith. Why? What is her role and what exactly does Jesus intend for her to do for us since he is God and can do all things? Fr. Chris Alar explains in the parish mission talk from Mechanicsburg, PA.

episodes.title: Understanding the Mass: A Walk-Thru (Part 2)
episodes.short: Understanding the Mass: A Walk-Thru (Part 2)
episodes.description: In Part 2 of this teaching Mass, Fr. Chris Alar begins at the Liturgy of the Eucharist and walks through each part of the Mass, explaining its Biblical foundation. You will never be bored at Mass again once you understand the full meaning of what is happening!

episodes.title: Understanding the Mass as Biblical: A Walk-Thru (Part 1)
episodes.short: Understanding the Mass as Biblical: A Walk-Thru (Part 1)
episodes.description: The main reason people don't attend Mass or are not focused during the Liturgy is because they don't fully understand what is taking place. Once one understands the Mass fully, one comes to love the Mass fully and their life changes. Fr. Chris Alar explains each and every line of the Mass and its Scriptural origin.

episodes.title: Marian Apparitions: Guadalupe: the Answer to Everything
episodes.short: Marian Apparitions: Guadalupe: the Answer to Everything
episodes.description: The threats to the world are many, especially the war in Ukraine and abortion in the United States. Interestingly, and much unknown, is the fact that the full answer to these problems lies at the feet of Our Lady of Guadalupe. In this second talk on Guadalupe, Fr. Chris Alar explains why.

episodes.title: The Image, Novena, Chaplet and Hour of Divine Mercy
episodes.short: The Image, Novena, Chaplet and Hour of Divine Mercy
episodes.description: In this talk, Fr. Chris Alar, MIC, gives a basic summary of the four important channels of grace in the Devotion of Divine Mercy - as given by Jesus to St. Faustina.

episodes.title: The Feast of Divine Mercy: What St. Faustina Said
episodes.short: The Feast of Divine Mercy: What St. Faustina Said
episodes.description: In this brief summary, Fr. Chris Alar explains who St. Faustina was and what Jesus told her we needed to know about the Feast of Divine Mercy. Learn how to receive these incredible graces!
